objective_value: <float> Total transportation cost across all vehicle routes.

routes.customers: <list[int], length varies> Ordered sequence of customer identifiers visited by this vehicle, starting after the depot and ending before the return to depot.
routes.cost: <int> Total travel distance for this route, including departure from and return to the depot.
routes.worst_case_demand: <int> Maximum possible total demand of the customers on this route over all demand realizations within the uncertainty set.
